display.purpose: Centered workshop title over the city photograph.

components.name: Academic Navigation
components.description: White navigation rail with the workshop name at left and anchor links at right.

components.name: Image Hero
components.description: Full-width Montréal photograph with a dark overlay and centered workshop metadata.

components.name: Schedule Table
components.description: A semantic, lightly ruled program table grouped into morning and afternoon sessions.

components.name: Person Portrait
components.description: A circular portrait or accessible initials fallback above the person's name and affiliation.

narrative.overview: A restrained, reference-led site with a white navigation bar, city-image hero, centered event metadata, and a single-column academic reading flow.
keyCharacteristics: White canvas with charcoal text and conventional blue links.
An 880px reading column with generous section spacing.
Light rules, plain lists, a semantic schedule table, and circular people portraits.
No gradients, dashboard motifs, decorative shadows, or entry animation.

rules.name: Reference Grammar
rules.body: Preserve the supplied workshop site's familiar white-nav, image-hero, and centered-content composition.

rules.name: Academic Restraint
rules.body: Let typography, whitespace, and light rules carry hierarchy instead of ornamental effects.

rules.name: Proposal Honesty
rules.body: Keep proposal status and tentative details explicit wherever event certainty matters.

dos: Do maintain the 880px reading measure and visible focus states.
Do keep all unconfirmed event details visibly tentative.
Do use circular portraits or accessible initials fallbacks for people.
donts: Don't restore the dark security-campaign visual system.
Don't add reveal animation, gradients, glows, or floating card shadows.
Don't imply official AAAI-27 acceptance or invent a submission destination.
